event_structure.source: code/3_main.do lines 293 and 318-327: gen yr_offset = year - event; eventdd lxrd lprivate_sales lprivate_sales_change, timevar(yr_offset) hdfe absorb(permno_adj year) cluster(permno_adj) keepbal(permno_adj) lags(4) leads(4): single-year leads 4..2 and lags 0..4, baseline -1 (eventdd default), no accumulation. keepbal keeps treated firms with all nine window years and only those years (re-implemented in keepbal_fig3.R), so treated rows outside -4..4 are trimmed: uncovered = drop (no such rows in fig3_eventdd_sample.csv). Article Eq. (2) and Figure 3. Years 1981-2015 consecutive, events 1991-1994 in sample, so rel = yr_offset = t - g.
event_structure.verified: fixest with these bins + the 2 controls, firm + year FE, cluster firm, on fig3_eventdd_sample.csv (N = 14908 incl. reghdfe singletons) reproduces the 8 eventdd coefficients in logs/3_main.log lines 655-670, max abs diff 4.9e-08 (SEs within 8e-07)

notes: Figure 3 Panel A (ln(R&D expenditures)), end-of-Cold-War event study: eventdd lxrd lprivate_sales lprivate_sales_change, timevar(yr_offset) hdfe absorb(permno_adj year) cluster(permno_adj) keepbal(permno_adj) lags(4) leads(4) (code/3_main.do Figure 3 block). Data: shipped anonymized DISCERN_panel.dta (real firm-year values, anonymized firm ids; not on the synthetic list). Sample built in Stata from a copy of the authors' lines 193-308 (~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2023.00087/build_fig3.do; counts match the authors' log exactly: 19,453 rows in 26 shocked sic3 industries, 2,520 treated rows). eventdd is not installed and could not be installed, so keepbal was re-implemented in R: treated firms are kept only if all 9 window years (-4..+4) are present in the data (irrespective of missing outcome/controls) and only their window years are kept; all control-firm years are kept (fig3_eventdd_sample.csv). This reproduces every lead/lag and control coefficient in the authors' 3_main.log to 7 decimals; N differs only by reghdfe-dropped singletons, which run_spec keeps. Treatment: event year 1991/1992/1993/1994 of the firm's sic3 procurement shock for firms with 1980-85 R&D contracts; after keepbal 73 treated firms (15/32/21/5 by cohort) and 1,284 never-treated control firms in the same industries; absorbing, no always-treated. Controls: lprivate_sales = ln(sales - all_contracts + 1e-6) and lprivate_sales_change = ln(private_sales) - ln(previous-row private_sales), both time-varying. published_coef = equal-weight average of the authors' lag0-lag4 coefficients from 3_main.log (no PDF/article text in the project; figure values taken from the authors' log), matching run_spec's post-window average; published_se not reported for the average. Window has no out-of-window treated rows, so run_spec's endpoint bins are empty and its TWFE event regression equals eventdd's. in_abstract_intro unknown (no article text); Figure 3 is the paper's only staggered binary design. NOV 2 AUDIT (event_structure): event_structure records eventdd's bins (leads 4..2, lags 0..4, baseline -1) and keepbal's trimming (uncovered = drop, a no-op on the prepared file).
published_source: Figure 3 of the article is graphical (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2023.00087.txt). published_coef = equal-weight average of the authors' lag0-lag4 eventdd coefficients in logs/3_main.log (authors' normalization, baseline -1); no published SE.
